scope: Production ARM64 stream shim, pinned XML DOM, allocator/resources and filesystem bridge with modeled OS, RO, filesystem and outer scheduling. Independent byte/position models and exact retained fixtures; no physical SD latency or durability claim.
acceptance_limits: Only documented read/seek/close APIs; no write/update/append modes or hosted stdio implementation
FILE declarations provide an opaque type only; no mixing with other stdio implementations or internal FILE access
One 512-byte buffer, owner allocation and cleanup registration per stream
File size is checked on refill; same-size changes and cached/disk inconsistency are not prevented
Large reads remain synchronous; cooperative callers must bound and yield their own work
Pending resource kernel and new stream probe require one combined physical Batch 8 acceptance
Physical performance, stack/RAM, low memory, media failures and long sessions remain open
Global constructors, static-local policy, exceptions, hosted STL and full Menyoo compatibility remain separate gates
